title: Analyst – Inside Sales
jobDescription: As an Analyst- Inside Sales, you are the starting point for inspiring our prospects to decide partnering with us through best-in-class lead generation practices. You work with our client facing teams to identify and follow up high quality leads and provide the best experience for our prospects across the entire sales lifecycle, thus contributing to building our overall business pipeline and helping us achieve our revenue and order booking targets.

title: Technical Trainer
jobDescription: Job Description Are you passionate about sharing knowledge and enhancing the skills of others? Join our Knowledge Management and Talent Development team at Sun Tec as a Trainer. As a Trainer, you will play a crucial role in delivering comprehensive training programs to both new hires and existing employees, focusing on Technical and Functional aspects. You will have the opportunity to stay updated with the latest technologies, be a knowledge champion within the organization, and contribute to the overall growth of our team. Key Responsibilities Create, plan, facilitate, and deliver technical, platform and product trainings. Co-ordinate the training programs end-to-end (from conception and kick-off, to conducting the program, evaluation, feedback, and post training follow-ups) Keep abreast of new technologies and industry trends. Continuously improve training programs at Sun Tec. Develop and execute talent development plans for each associate. Create or curate content and courses to enhance the technical competency of the organization. Deliver training programs to enhance the knowledge of the organization. Academic Qualifications A Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in Engineering or a relevant field of study Skills Required Knowledge of Java 8 or later versions. Understanding of DBMS principles and experience working with SQL. Passionate about sharing knowledge. Very Good communication skills. Enthusiastic about continuous learning. Experience: 2 to 6 yrs Please share your resume to [email protected] If you’d like to recommend a friend, feel free to send them these details soon!
